name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold exploration and development company focused on its flagship Diablillos project in San Juan province, Argentina, which it holds 100%. The company completed a Pre-Feasibility Study on Diablillos and is advancing toward a feasibility study, with the project hosting a significant silver-gold resource. AbraSilver is in the advanced exploration and development stage, with an ongoing drill program expanding the deposit.
